en: Um, right, yeah. Thanks!
Heh. I've had lots of idols run on this show, but not many have been able to do it in just one take.
Really? Well, I'm glad you got a usable take. All I did was run as fast as I could.
Hahah, that's the most important thing! You can only achieve true satisfaction when you really give it your all!
A satisfaction so powerful, even the viewers can feel it burning through them!
Yeah, I get it... I think.
Hey, AD! I feel that fire burning inside me! I need a break⑬finish up for me here, will you?
All right. You got it!
Oh, okay! Thank you very much, sir!
Okay, folks! That's a wrap! Let's pack it up!
Oh! Thank you.
Not bad! Not bad at all! You came really close to giving me the take I wanted to see! So, so close!
I wish all the girls who came on this show were like you. It'd certainly make my job a lot easier.
Thank you very much! I'm so glad you were pleased with my performance.
Hahaha. Now, if only my private life were as easy to navigate as this shoot! Am I right!?
Hey, AD! My wife's in a real mood today, so I'm heading for the hills! Finish up for me here, will you?
You got it! Sorry to hear about the wife again, sir.
Good try, Sawamura-san.
Please. Tell me you're pulling my leg.
...Sorry?
Come on, kid! A three-toed sloth can run faster than that! Is that really the best you can do?
Hey, AD! Today's stuff is completely unusable. Garbage! We'll have to come back another day.
Roger that!
I'm going home. Finish up for me here, will you?
Yep, you got it!
Well, you heard the director.
We'll have to try again another day. I hope you'll be able to do a little better for us next time.
I'll certainly try.
All right, folks! That's it for today! Let's pack it up!
You've been through this before, so you already know what you gotta do, right?
I could use a refresher. If you wouldn't mind, could you explain it to me once more?
You know, a real professional would only need to be told once.
Come on! It's not even that complicated!
Yes, I'm ready. Thank you.
Good job, Sawamura-san.
You got 1,100 experience points.
(Phew... I'm tired. Maybe I should take a break...)

You will not be able to take on jobs when your health is low.

It's a good idea to check your health level before accessing
the schedule board.

(There's some information from the agency here. I think I'll
check it out.)
(I think I'll read about taking on jobs.)

Take a look at the schedule board to see a list of available
jobs. Select a job from this list to take it on.
Completing jobs improves Haruka's idol abilities, so try to
take on as many different jobs as you can.

Upon completing a job, the agency will deposit your wages
into your account.

You can withdraw your wages at a convenience store ATM.

Should you fail a job, you will become exhausted and lose
health.

For the best results, be sure you're prepared before taking
on a job.
(I think I'll read about idol abilities.)
(I think I'll read about enhancing the agency.)

The agency is paid whenever you complete a job.
As these payments build up, the agency's level rises.

As the agency levels up, its publicity, media, and lessons
are enhanced.

Publicity: Enhance publicity to add promotional event jobs.

Media: Enhance media to add TV and press jobs.

Lessons: Enhance lessons to speed up growth.

You can now take on promotional event jobs sponsored by
Dyna Chair. These jobs garner more fans than those
sponsored by others.

You can now take on new TV and press jobs. Check them out on
the job schedule screen.

With an improved lesson studio environment, you will gain
more benefits from lessons.

Both Singing and Appeal can now be raised more efficiently.

You can now take on new TV and press jobs. Check them
out on the job schedule screen.

You can now take on new promotional event jobs. Check them
out on the job schedule screen.

You can now take on hard lessons. Hard lessons are more

exhausting than regular lessons but more rewarding if you
succeed.

When the number of fans reaches certain levels, gifts for
Haruka are delivered to Dyna Chair.

Gifts can be found in the gift box next to the desks.
Hello, Haruka-san. We've been looking forward to your arrival.
Hello, Uda-san.
This is a very important event for us at the Merchants Association.
We hope it'll be an important and successful event for you too, Haruka-san.
Yes, me too!
Good. Your entire fan club, including me, believes in you and is looking forward to you performing spectacularly.
Oh gosh, Uda-san. Thank you.
No thanks needed. All we do is provide a stage for your talents. The rest is up to you!
I'll do my very best!
(I've done this kind of thing before, so I guess I don't need to. I'm ready!)

In live events, just as in lessons, your goal is to meet the specified performance requirements.

During the event, these will be displayed at the top right of the screen.

There are three performance requirements per event. At the end of the song, the level of your success in each of these areas will determine the overall result.

Great Ratings
The number of times you receive a Great rating for correct button presses.

Max Combo
The maximum number of consecutive Good or better ratings you achieve.

Score
The rank you obtain.
(I'm ready. Let's do this!)
Haruka-san, thank you for your performance.
What did you think, Uda-san? Did I do all right?
You did more than all right! That was fantastic!
I'm so glad! Thank you so much for the opportunity!
Ah, before I forget! One of the fans left you a gift.
Oh! For me?
Here you are.
You got <Color:8>Dance Fever Scrunchie<Color:Default>.
Oh, how nice!
It looks like people are really rooting for you.
Yes, I'm very lucky.
I'm already looking forward to next time. You will perform for us again, I hope?
Yes, of course! Thank you for asking me!
Yes, that was very good! It seemed like the audience was really getting into it, too.
I'm so glad! I had a lot of fun, too.
Here's hoping we can get a bigger crowd next time.
Yes, I'll do my best!
I'm already looking forward to it. Thank you for today.
Thank you for having me!
Uda-san?
Uh, Haruka-san... Your voice sounds a little raspy. Maybe you better go home, have a soothing throat treatment, and get some rest.
Right. Well, that's it for today.
Thank you for inviting me.
(Oh no. Uda-san was mad. I'd better start taking better care of my voice.)
Hello, Haruka-san. Thank you for coming today.
Hello, Uda-san. Thank you very much for having me.
There are a lot of guests here already. We're ready when you are.
All right. Wish me luck!
You got <Color:8>Toughness Light<Color:Default>.
(I've done this before. I guess I don't really need to.)
You got a <Color:8>Toughness Light<Color:Default>.
Hello! Sir, Sawamura-san is here.
Oh, hello! It's very nice to meet you. I'm the director of this event.
Hello. I'm Haruka Sawamura. It's very nice to meet you, too!
We appreciate you coming today.
I will be representing Soten Town, the sponsor of today's event.
Remember, the fans are here for you, so please enjoy yourself!
Ten more minutes!
Okay, the show's gonna be starting soon! I'll let you get ready.
Sawamura-san, thank you!
Whew! I can't believe it's over!
That was just incredible! An encore and everything!
Hehe, I could hardly believe it myself! The crowd was fantastic!
It was all thanks to your stellar performance. You were on fire!
Well, the audience was so responsive, I just wanted to do everything I could to make them happy.
And the more you put into it, the more they responded. They were going wild!
They were, weren't they? I really feel like we connected. Oh, I had so much fun!
That went well! I saw a lot of smiling faces.
Hmm. I felt I sang well enough, but I think I needed to put a bit more feeling into it.
Either way, I believe the people here today will definitely want to see more of you.
Do you really think so? Oh, I hope that's true.
We'd love for you to come back and join us again, too!
Of course! Thank you!
I apologize for not being able to make today's event more of a success for you.
I feel like we let you down.
Oh, of course not! It's all my fault. I just didn't sing very well today.
No. As director, I should have taken more care and asked you about your condition. I am deeply sorry.
Please, give me the chance to do a better job next time.
Oh gosh, you have nothing to apologize for. I'm the one who needs to do a better job.
(The poor director is apologizing even though it's all my fault. I can't let this happen again.)
Hello, Sawamura-san. It's a pleasure to be working with you again.
You too! Thank you so much for setting up another of these events.
Well, it's not exactly "another" one.
A lot of people missed out on seeing you the first time.
So we decided to hold the event again, to make it up to them.
Oh, I see! That's wonderful!
Okay, it's almost time to start. Knock 'em dead!
Hello, Sawamura-san! Let us know when you're ready!
(I'm so glad there was a big crowd today. Some people even told me I made some new fans out of them!)
(I have to keep working hard so all my performances are this good!)
(I'm glad people seemed to be getting into it towards the end, even though a few of them looked bored the whole time.)
(I have to find a way to make sure everyone has a good time!)
(Oh no. That was nowhere near what I can usually do. No wonder people started leaving.)
(I have to be able to give it one hundred percent, no matter what. I'd better take more lessons.)
(I'm so glad there was a big crowd today. A few people even told me I made some new fans out of them!)
Hello, Sawamura-san. Thank you for coming.
Hello. Thank you very much for having me!
Have you ever watched the show you're going to be on today?
No, I'm sorry. I'm afraid I haven't.
All right. Then let me give you a brief rundown.
Sotenbori Love Check Quiz is a late-night quiz show.
As the title suggests, the show features trivia questions about Sotenbori, and tests the contestant's love for the town.
The questions are all multiple choice, with only two options. You hold up a ○ sign or a × sign to choose your answer.
You're free to do anything you want until recording starts.
(What should I do? Should I make sure I understand how the show's going to work?)
(No, I guess I don't need to. I think I've got it.)
Sawamura-san, recording will start soon. Are you ready?
(I'd better make sure I understand what's gonna happen.)

During this quiz, you'll be asked ten trivia questions.
The questions are multiple choice, so choose either ○ or × to select your answer.
Press <Action:Button_Circle@Press_Events> to hold up the ○ sign, or <Action:Button_Cross@Press_Events> to hold up the × sign.

Try to get as many as you can correct!

You will have ten seconds to answer each question. If you don't answer within that time, it will be counted as an incorrect answer.

Your goal is to answer at least seven questions correctly, but if you manage to get all ten questions right, your reward will be greater.
(I think I'd better run through it one more time.)
(Yeah, I've got it!)
Sawamura-san! As a first-time guest on the show, would you like to say a few words before we begin?
Oh, I, um⑬ I've never done this before, so I'm really nervous, but I'll do my best!
It sounds like you should do your best to calm your nerves! Ahaha.
Anyway, let's get started.
Sotenbori Love Check Quiz⑬begin!

Excellent! I hope you can keep up the good
work. Now, on to the next question.

I'm sorry. I'm afraid that's incorrect.
Better luck on the next question!

I'm sorry. I'm afraid you're out of time.
Let's go on to the next question.
You are correct!
I'm afraid you are incorrect.
I'm afraid you're out of time.
Now, Sawamura-san, let's see how you did!
You got all ten questions correct!
With all ten questions correct, you win the title of "Sotenbori Fanatic" and 30,000 yen!
You won <Color:8>30,000 yen<Color:Default>.
So that's it. Join us next time, on Sotenbori Love Check Quiz!
You did very well!
For meeting the seven-question goal, you win the title of "Sotenbori Buff" and 10,000 yen!
You won <Color:8>10,000 yen<Color:Default>.
I'm sorry, but you weren't a winner this time.
Oh, darn.
I hope this doesn't mean you're lacking in love for good ol' Sotenbori!
Hello. Thank you very much for having me.
(I'd better make sure I understand.)
